messages:
Alex K.: Heads-up — opened a PR that splits provider blocks out of modules and pins provider sources/versions at the root to avoid drift across modules. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/342
Alex K.: Key question: should I update .terraform.lock.hcl in this PR (we currently check it in) or make a follow-up where CI regenerates? Some folks see plan diffs locally depending on Terraform/provider versions.
Maria R.: 👀 can you paste the provider block you used?
Alex K.: ```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.50.0"
    }
  }
}
```
Devon P.: Short answer — update the lockfile in the same PR. We want the checked-in lockfile to reflect the tested provider combo. CI should validate it rather than letting every dev generate their own.
Devon P.: Suggested steps: 1) run `terraform init` then `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` (or the CI platform set) 2) commit the updated .terraform.lock.hcl 3) add a CI gate that fails if `terraform init` would change the lockfile.
Alex K.: We're keeping the same provider source (hashicorp/aws). No namespace change so no state replace-provider needed, right?
Devon P.: Correct — if source stays the same, state migration isn't necessary. If you did change source or provider namespace we'd run `terraform state replace-provider` with a plan/backup.
Alex K.: One small follow-up — some of our tests pass on 4.51.0. Any objections to bumping to ~> 4.51.0 while I'm here?
Maria R.: I'd prefer you stick to the exact version you validated in the PR. If you want 4.51.0, run the full staging e2e and add a short note in the PR description and CHANGELOG so platform teams know.
InfraBot: CI check completed — terraform fmt, tflint OK. Plan step: warnings only. (link to CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/9987)
Devon P.: Also add a tiny CI check we use elsewhere: after `terraform init -input=false`, run `git diff --exit-code .terraform.lock.hcl` (or fail if `git status --porcelain` shows changes). Prevents accidental regen drift.
Alex K.: Good idea — I'll add that check and commit the regenerated lockfile. Tagging @Maria R. for final review.
Maria R.: LGTM :thumbsup: please include the CHANGELOG blurb.
Alex K.: Will do. Merging after CI passes :shipit:
